name: reverie-recall-eval
about: Invented people and places only (Jane Doe, John Doe, Sam Rivera and friends, in Elmwood, Harborview, Millbrook and Kestrel Bay). Memories are written in order of occurredOn, each at noon of its own day; a memory with supersedes is written with memory.supersede. Recall runs at now. Expected answers are call numbers, which the runner checks against the numbers the silo issues.

memories.title: Home on Birch Row
memories.body: I live at 12 Birch Row in Elmwood, on the top floor.

memories.title: Odile prefers letters
memories.body: Odile Marchetti is my landlady. She prefers a letter through the door over a phone call for anything about repairs.

memories.title: Jane teaches geography
memories.body: Jane Doe teaches geography at Harborview Secondary School.

memories.title: Spare key in the ceramic frog
memories.body: The spare key to the flat is inside the hollow ceramic frog on the balcony, not under the mat.

memories.title: Flat white with oat milk
memories.body: I take my coffee as a flat white with oat milk.

memories.title: Bin collection day
memories.body: Bin collection in Elmwood is on Thursdays. Recycling goes out on alternate weeks, starting with the first Thursday of the month.

memories.title: Train for short journeys
memories.body: For trips under five hours I take the train rather than fly.

memories.title: Sam's red hatchback
memories.body: Sam Rivera drives a red Corvel hatchback, old enough that the passenger door only opens from inside.

memories.title: Folding kettle on trips
memories.body: On trips I pack a folding kettle and loose leaf tea; hotel tea bags are not worth drinking.

memories.title: Band website domain
memories.body: The domain for the band website is registered with Portline, under my personal account.

memories.title: Jane and mushrooms
memories.body: Jane Doe does not eat mushrooms and asks for them to be left off every dish.

memories.title: Short sentences, British spelling
memories.body: In my writing I prefer short sentences and British spelling.

memories.title: Sea kayaking at Kestrel Bay
memories.body: Drove to Kestrel Bay with John Doe for a weekend of sea kayaking. We stayed at the Saltmarsh Inn, room 4, which looks out over the estuary.

memories.title: Window cleaner schedule
memories.body: The window cleaner comes on the first Saturday of every month and leaves the ladder by the side gate.

memories.title: Helix with a light theme
memories.body: I write code in Helix with a light theme; dark themes give me eye strain in daylight.

memories.title: Street barbecue with Tomas
memories.body: Tomas Berg fired up his smoker for a street barbecue on our road in Elmwood. He smoked brisket for eleven hours and the whole block came.

memories.title: Climbing at Brightwater
memories.body: Lena Ortiz and I climb at Brightwater climbing gym on Tuesday evenings.

memories.title: Felix in year 3
memories.body: Felix Doe is in year 3 at Harborview Primary.

memories.title: Noor's violin lessons
memories.body: Noor Rivera started violin lessons at the Fernhill music school with a teacher called Mrs Abbot.

memories.title: Tomas's whippet Pilot
memories.body: Tomas Berg has a grey whippet called Pilot who is afraid of bicycles.

memories.title: Pro plan at 6 euros
memories.body: NightStash Pro costs 6 euros a month.

memories.title: Cabin at Larchmont Lake
memories.body: Rented a cabin at Larchmont Lake with Sam and Noor. Noor caught her first perch from the jetty.

memories.title: John restores dinghies
memories.body: John Doe restores old wooden sailing dinghies in a boathouse near Harborview harbour.

memories.title: Felix the lighthouse
memories.body: Felix went trick or treating in Harborview dressed as a lighthouse. John built the costume from a lampshade.

memories.title: Priya leads mobile
memories.body: Priya Nair leads the NightStash mobile app team.

memories.title: Gifts for Sam
memories.body: Sam Rivera likes gifts he can use outdoors; he has no shelf space for ornaments.

memories.title: NightStash storage
memories.body: NightStash stores its sync data in SQLite on the device and Postgres on the server.

memories.title: Tomas's brisket rub
memories.body: Tomas's brisket rub recipe is saved at recipes.example.org/tomas-brisket.

memories.title: Marcus wants weekly emails
memories.body: Marcus Hale at Brindle Foods wants weekly status reports by email on Mondays.

memories.title: Brindle contract
memories.body: Brindle Foods signed a six month contract for a stock tracking dashboard. Marcus Hale is the contact.

memories.title: Christmas Eve, oven failed
memories.body: Hosted Christmas Eve at my flat in Elmwood. The oven quit halfway through roasting, so Jane, John and Sam ate takeaway pizza from Luigi's on the floor by the tree.

memories.title: New year on the pier
memories.body: Rang in the new year on the pier at Kestrel Bay with Sam and Lena, watching the fireworks over the harbour wall.

memories.title: Sync outage
memories.body: The NightStash sync outage lasted three hours: a certificate on the push gateway expired and nobody had renewed it.

memories.title: Router in the hallway cupboard
memories.body: The router lives in the hallway cupboard. When the internet drops, unplug it for thirty seconds before calling the provider.

memories.title: Met Ravi at an open mic
memories.body: Met Ravi Kapoor at an open mic at the Saltmarsh Inn, and we talked about starting a band.

memories.title: Split keyboard
memories.body: My keyboard is a split Kestrel 42 with brown switches, and the spare keycaps are in the desk drawer.

memories.title: The Night Owls
memories.body: Ravi Kapoor and I started a band called The Night Owls. We rehearse in his garage.

memories.title: Boiler reset button
memories.body: The boiler is a Vexa 24C. The reset button sits behind the white panel on its left side, and it needs holding for ten seconds.

memories.title: Aiko and feedback
memories.body: Aiko Tanaka designed the NightStash onboarding screens. She wants feedback as annotated screenshots, not long messages.

memories.title: Support inbox
memories.body: Work email for NightStash runs through Fastmail; the shared support inbox forwards to Priya and me.

memories.title: Sam's cargo bike
memories.body: Sam Rivera sold the red hatchback and now cycles everywhere on a cargo bike with a seat for Noor.

memories.title: Release day
memories.body: NightStash releases go out on Wednesdays after the 2pm stand-up, and not on Fridays.

memories.title: Sam Rivera turned 40
memories.body: Sam Rivera turned 40. We rented the back room of the Copperpot cafe in Ashgrove, and Lena brought a cake shaped like a climbing hold.

memories.title: Aiko's jasmine tea
memories.body: Aiko Tanaka drinks only jasmine tea at meetings.

memories.title: Osprey wants two languages
memories.body: Osprey Lettings asked for their tenant portal in Dutch and English; the Dutch copy comes from their own translator.

memories.title: Green Halvard tourer
memories.body: My bicycle is a green Halvard tourer, kept in the communal shed. Jane knows the lock combination.

memories.title: Nightly laptop backups
memories.body: Laptop backups run nightly to the grey external drive labelled ATLAS.

memories.title: Pro plan at 8 euros
memories.body: NightStash Pro went up to 8 euros a month, with a yearly plan at 80 euros.

memories.title: Fellowship stays local
memories.body: Fellowship stays a local app on port 4319. We decided against a hosted version.

memories.title: Pinecrest trail map
memories.body: The Pinecrest trail map with the fire tower shortcut is at trails.example.org/pinecrest.

memories.title: Pinecrest loop in hail
memories.body: Hiked the Pinecrest trail loop with Lena Ortiz, 14 kilometres. We turned back at the fire tower because of hail.

memories.title: Lena lives in Millbrook
memories.body: Lena Ortiz moved from Ashgrove to Millbrook, ten minutes from me.

memories.title: Bouldering at Granite Hall
memories.body: Lena Ortiz and I moved our climbing sessions to the Granite Hall bouldering wall in Millbrook, on Wednesday evenings.

memories.title: Housewarming on Quillon Street
memories.body: Jane and John held a housewarming in their new place on Quillon Street in Harborview. Felix gave everyone a tour of his treehouse.

memories.title: NightStash 2.0 launch
memories.body: Launched NightStash 2.0 with offline folders. Priya and I watched the signups chart from the Copperpot cafe.

memories.title: Marcus wants calls
memories.body: Marcus Hale now wants a fortnightly video call instead of the weekly email report.

memories.title: Outage blog draft
memories.body: My blog draft about offline-first sync lives in the Drafts folder under the title Lessons from the Outage.

memories.title: Packing for the move
memories.body: Packed the flat into forty boxes with Jane and Sam. The piano needed four people and a ramp.

memories.title: Home on Larkspur Lane
memories.body: Moved to 7 Larkspur Lane in Millbrook. The flat is on the ground floor with a small garden.

memories.title: Noor's first recital
memories.body: Noor Rivera played her first violin recital at the Fernhill music school. She performed a minuet and bowed twice.

memories.title: Tomas waters the tomatoes
memories.body: Tomas Berg waters my tomato plants whenever I travel, and likes to be paid back in jars of chutney.

memories.title: Renamed The Lanterns
memories.body: The band renamed itself The Lanterns after finding another group called The Night Owls.

memories.title: Priya leads billing
memories.body: Priya Nair moved from the mobile team to lead NightStash billing and subscriptions.

memories.title: Sailing the Merrow
memories.body: Went out with John Doe on the Merrow, the dinghy he finished restoring. We capsized once near the breakwater.

memories.title: Lantern festival in Vellmar
memories.body: Took the night train to Vellmar for the lantern festival with Jane. The paper lanterns were released at midnight over the river Tarn.

memories.title: Raised beds in Millbrook
memories.body: Spent the afternoon building raised beds in the Millbrook garden with Tomas's old drill, then planted garlic and broad beans.

memories.title: Lunch with Marcus
memories.body: Lunch with Marcus Hale in Millbrook: Brindle Foods wants to extend the dashboard to their two warehouses.

memories.title: Black filter coffee
memories.body: I switched to black filter coffee, with no milk at all.

memories.title: Jane runs the maritime museum
memories.body: Jane Doe left teaching and now runs the Harborview Maritime Museum as its director.

memories.title: Felix in year 4
memories.body: Felix Doe moved up to year 4 and joined the school chess club.

memories.title: First gig at the Saltmarsh Inn
memories.body: Played our first gig as The Lanterns at the Saltmarsh Inn. Ravi broke a bass string in the second song and we finished the set with three strings.

memories.title: Dario joins backend
memories.body: Hired Dario Pellegrini as the second NightStash backend engineer. He starts on 2026-10-05.

memories.title: Curry night at Priya's
memories.body: Priya Nair cooked a Kerala fish curry for the NightStash team at her flat, and Aiko brought mango lassi.

memories.title: Felix's first chess win
memories.body: Felix Doe won his first chess tournament at Harborview library, and Jane filmed the final move.

memories.title: Osprey workshop
memories.body: Workshop at Osprey Lettings in Millbrook. They chose the teal colour scheme and dropped the chat widget.

memories.title: Meetup talk
memories.body: Accepted a talk slot at the Millbrook Developers Meetup on 2026-12-03 about local-first apps.
